common_errors.rationale: 4 is the axis of symmetry of g, not k, which is twice the axis.

answers.explanation: The graph of f is symmetric about x = 2. The graph of g is symmetric where 2x − 6 = 2, at x = 4. A graph symmetric about x = 4 satisfies g(x) = g(8 − x). Directly: g(8 − x) = f(2(8 − x) − 6) = f(10 − 2x) = f(4 − (2x − 6)) = f(2x − 6) = g(x).

distractor_explanations.C: This subtracts only the x² term of the second numerator and adds its 4.
